name: ErrorSummary
description: Mortar foundation error summary: the problems that stopped a form submitting, each linking to its field.

props.errors: { message: string; href?: string; target?: string }[] (renders nothing when empty; href defaults to #target, target to the id in an in-page href)
props.title: string (default "There is a problem")
props.autoFocus: boolean (default true: focus moves to the summary when it appears and when submitCount changes)
props.submitCount: number (failed submits; a change moves focus to the summary again)

contract.usage: Import { ErrorSummary } from @tony-ui/mortar. Place it above the form, pass the same messages as the fields' `error` props with each field's id as `target`, and pass the count of failed submits as `submitCount`.
contract.avoid: Do not autofocus it on page load before any submit, list errors that are not shown on their fields, or copy implementations or override central colours.
contract.accessibility: role="alert" labelled by its heading, and tabIndex=-1 so it takes focus after a failed submit. Each link moves focus to its field (the checked or first control of a group) and scrolls its label or legend into view without changing the URL.
